caption:
Bill Gates says artificial intelligence will eventually fix the world, but the next twenty years will bring massive job losses and chaos. When the ultra-rich start telling you to prepare for a twenty-year bumpy ride, maybe it is time to check your career plan. How are you future-proofing your job against robots? 🤖💼

Source: Business Insider

#artificialintelligence #futureofwork #billgates #techtrends #creatoreconomy
